propositions: rebar-debug skill closes defects without recording the originating ticket via caused_by link, making defect escape rate unmeasurable
blame fallback incorrectly attributes defects to whoever wrote most lines in fixed files rather than to whoever introduced the actual defect

blame fallback cannot detect unmet-obligation cases where fix site differs from cause site—a producer change creates requirements but consumers are never updated, yet defect is charged to consumer's old ticket
caused_by is already a first-class relation in rebar with transition command support and metrics consumption, but skill lacks the attribution step to populate it before bug close
close-time --caused-by flag must be explicitly provided even when caused_by link was already recorded via rebar link, else _apply_caused_by adds a second guessed edge beside the proven one
worktree bootstrap via bare git worktree add does not provision virtualenv, causing pre-commit hook failures on missing ruff/mypy even when code is clean
